Q5787.reason: Intent to wound isn't intent to kill or depraved-heart malice, so murder is doubtful; of the remaining options, the answer hinges on whether this counts as voluntary manslaughter, but the unintended killing during an unlawful act is more likely involuntary manslaughter.
